records.text: Sarah Tewell said the shot entered Charlie Kirk's left side from her right and estimated the shooter was about 200 yards away.
records.speaker: Sarah Tewell

appearances.snippet: Yes, correct. Yeah, it went right into his left side and the shooter was from my right and even in the middle it was still to the right. And I'm pretty sure you had somebody say this earlier, but I think it was about 200 yards away.

verification.notes: Transcript context reviewed. Archived interview footage records Tewell saying the shot entered on the left side, came from her right, and was roughly 200 yards away. This verifies her attributed account, not the objective trajectory or distance.
